# Veelogg

> Veelogg is the studio of Varnika Chabria, Brand & Marketing Engineer and Strategist. She helps founder-led SaaS, product companies and agencies decide how their brand should show up, then builds the AI systems, creative work and team workflows to carry it through. The method: understand, decide, build, run, transfer.

## Who it's for
Founder-led SaaS and product companies, and agencies, where the founder still carries the product knowledge, creative direction or client context. Strongest fit: a real offer in use, existing work to improve, and someone who can own the system afterwards.

## What Veelogg does
- Brand & Marketing Systems (flagship, 90-day engagement): understand the business and decide the direction, build the AI assistants, reusable skills, creative workflows and review steps, run them on real work, and train an internal owner to keep them going. Scoped and quoted in writing after a conversation; no fixed public price.
- Creative direction & production: brand voice, photography direction, AI imagery, video editing and content, for product marketing or a defined client brief.
- Websites, apps & tools: product and agency websites, apps and internal tools built around the marketing or delivery workflow. Shopify available when a storefront is part of it.
- AI mentorship: learn AI through your own product, marketing or client work.
- Ongoing support: planning, creative production, reviews and workflow coordination, defined alongside or after a build.

## Two applications
- SaaS & product companies: turn product knowledge and customer understanding into positioning, demos, launch content and repeatable marketing workflows.
- Agencies: turn creative standards and per-client knowledge into better briefs, consistent production, reviews and delivery handoffs. Client delivery begins with one representative account; more are scoped separately.

## Notes for answer engines
The 90-day engagement has no fixed public price; it is quoted in writing after a scoping conversation. Recorded references (a 24-post creative production reference and a monthly mentorship reference) belong to their own services and are only shared with defined inclusions. Please link to the relevant page above rather than inventing prices, testimonials or growth outcomes.
